armoury.title: Armoury
armoury.intro: Gear found in caskets, upgraded here for good: from then on it comes out of every casket as what it's become.
armoury.not_found: Not found yet: find it in a casket to upgrade it.
armoury.no_upgrade: There's nothing to upgrade it into.
canvas.ability_guide: Dodge the boss's big attacks to drop its guard, then get close.
canvas.ability_guide_action: this while it's down: it hits twice as hard.
canvas.ability_hint: {name}: from right by him, and twice as hard while his guard's down
canvas.boss_penalty: -{percent}% damage to bosses: they pray against {style}
canvas.boss_penalty_most: -{percent}% damage to most bosses: they pray against {style}
canvas.controls.damage: Show or hide the damage panel
canvas.controls.highlight: Move the highlight, on menus and level ups
canvas.controls.items: Use items 1 to 4 (a boss fight has none)
canvas.controls.pause: Pause and resume; on the map screen, enter the map
canvas.controls.press: Press what's highlighted; in a fight with its own button, use it
canvas.controls.quests: Show or hide the quest tracker
canvas.graphics_lost: Your device took the game's graphics away, as it can when it's short of memory, and they can't come back without reloading.
canvas.reload_kept: Reload to play again: the coins and quests from this run are kept.
canvas.rotate_phone: Turn your phone sideways to play
canvas.teleport_desc: Uses one of this raid's teleports.
chest.banish_hint: Alch it, and never see it in a casket again this run
chest.banish_set_hint: Alch it, and no {set} pieces in a casket again this run
chest.instant: Yours the moment you take it.
collection.title: Collection log
collection.evolution_intro: Max a weapon and own its passive, and the next level up can evolve it.
collection.locked_hint: Max the {weapon} and own {passive} to find out what it makes.
coop.disband_hint: Send everyone back to the co-op menu
coop.flag_label_self: Other players see you playing from
coop.intro: A run with up to {n} friends. Each of you brings your own adventurer, skills and Armoury.
coop.lost_room: Lost the connection to the room.
coop.lost_server: Lost the connection to the co-op server.
coop.no_open_rooms: No open rooms right now. Make one!
coop.not_connected: Not connected to the co-op server.
coop.open_room_title: Open rooms are listed for anyone
coop.open_room_title_flag: Open rooms are listed for anyone, and show your flag to whoever joins
coop.rooms_full: All rooms are taken right now. Try again when one opens.
coop.title: Multiplayer
coop.waiting_ready: Waiting for everyone to be ready
coop.you_down_note: You're down. A teammate standing over you can revive you ({left}).
coop.you_missing_unlock: You need {what} unlocked to join this room.
coop.gone.disconnected_idle: Disconnected after a while with nothing happening.
coop.gone.idle: The room closed after half an hour with nothing happening.
coop.gone.kicked: The host removed you from the party.
coop.gone.host_left_party: The host left, so the party's over.
coop.gone.host_left_run: The host left, so the run's over.
quest.title: Quests
quest.intro: Quests take as many runs as they need. Each pays its coins once, when the run that finishes it ends.
save.other_tab_body_1: Run Escape is open in another tab, and only one can save your progress. Play here, and that one stops saving.
save.other_tab_body_2: Or play without saving: what you earn here lasts until that tab closes or this one reloads.
save.newer_title: Your save is from a newer version
save.newer_body: It was saved by{saved} Run Escape, and this is v{version}, which would undo what's new in it. So this one won't save.
save.newer_reload: Reload to get the new version.
save.newer_anyway_warning: If it doesn't come, save anyway: you lose what was new in your save, and nothing else.
save.no_room_body_1: Something went wrong with the save in this browser, and there's no room to keep a copy of it. So this one won't save over it.
save.no_room_body_2: Export it to mend by hand or ask for help on the Discord, then free some space in this browser and reload.
save.unreadable_body_1: Something went wrong with the save in this browser, so you're starting afresh. A copy of the old one has been kept.
save.unreadable_body_2: Export it to ask for help on the Discord, or to mend by hand and import. It's in Settings too.
save.export_reminder_first: Your progress is kept only on this device. Export a copy to keep it safe.
save.export_reminder: Last exported {date}. Export a fresh copy to keep it safe.
toast.controller_unknown: {name} connected. Its buttons aren't on a layout the browser knows, so only its stick works.
toast.round: Round {round} begins! Monsters have {hp} the hitpoints and hit {damage} as hard, and caskets' gear comes +{gear}.
toast.coop_lost_others: Lost the connection to the others. The run goes on without them.
toast.coop_lost_server: Lost the connection to the co-op server.
toast.missing_run_content: That run needs a map or adventurer your game doesn't have.
toast.character_unlocked: The {name} joins you after this run.
toast.item_loot_unlocked: {name} joins the loot after this run.
toast.item_unlocked: {name} can be found after this run.
toast.quest_complete: Quest complete: {name}! {coins} coins are yours after this run.
toast.decided_for_you: Everyone was waiting, so that was decided for you.
toast.out_of_step: Integrity check failed: your game and the host's stopped matching, so your run ended.
coop.run_stuck: Something went wrong in the run, so it ended.
coop.run_cant_catch_up: Your connection dropped for too long to catch up, so your run ended.
cloud.title: Cloud save
cloud.problem.offline: Can't reach cloud save right now. Your progress is still kept here.
cloud.problem.unknown_code: That code isn't one cloud save knows.
cloud.problem.deleted: That code's cloud save was deleted. Restore brings it back.
cloud.problem.refused: Cloud save wouldn't take this save. Export it to keep a copy.
cloud.problem.deleted_until: That code's cloud save was deleted. It's kept until {date}, and Restore brings it back.
cloud.problem.code_dead: This code doesn't work any more: New code was used on another device, or it went unused for weeks. Turn off, then type in the new code or turn cloud save on again.
cloud.summary: {runs} runs, {wins} wins, {maps} maps beaten, {coins} coins earned
cloud.off.text: Keep a copy online, and take it to another device with a code. No account, name or email.
cloud.have_code.name: Have a code?
cloud.have_code.text: From another device, to bring its save here
cloud.turn_off_confirm: Stop syncing on this device? The cloud keeps its copy, for your code's other devices.
cloud.two_saves.name: Two saves
cloud.two_saves.text: The cloud has a different save from this one
cloud.your_code.name: Your sync code
cloud.your_code.text: Type it on another device to bring this save there. Anyone with it can load or replace your save, and it can't be recovered, so keep it safe. If it gets out, New code shuts the old one out.
cloud.new_code_confirm: Get a new code for this save? The old one stops working everywhere, so your other devices will need the new one typed in.
cloud.delete.name: Delete the cloud copy
cloud.delete.text: And the code. It's kept for a week in case you change your mind.
cloud.delete_confirm: Delete the cloud copy of your save? The save on this device stays, and the code stops working everywhere. For a week, Restore in Settings brings it back, here or on any device you type the code into.
cloud.choice.title: Which save do you want?
cloud.choice.different: Your cloud save is different from the one on this device.
cloud.choice.newer: The cloud's is from a newer version of Run Escape than this one (v{version}). Reload or update to use it. Keeping this device's replaces it, and loses what's new in it.
cloud.choice.replaced: The one you don't keep is replaced. Export this one first to keep both.
cloud.button.label: Cloud save: {status}

cinematic.vardhelm.merlin: I shall find you a champion.

notice.teleporter_dormant: The teleporter's dormant: you've used all your teleports this raid.
notice.chest_funny_feeling: You have a funny feeling there would've been a chest

toast.you_down_revivable: You're down! A teammate standing over you for a few seconds can revive you.
toast.you_down: You're down! Watch the rest of your party fight on.
toast.revived_you: {name} revives you! Nothing can hurt you for {minutes} minutes.
toast.extra_revive_you: A teammate can revive you once more ({revives}).
toast.teammate_down_revivable: {name} is down! Stand over them to revive them.
notice.room_cleared: Room cleared! Boss down in {time}: +{points} raid points, +{coins} coins.
notice.akkha_turns: Akkha turns to {style}, and protects from {protects}!
notice.collection_log: New item added to your collection log: {item}
